 Search The Site Chris Janson Gets Vocal About Morgan Wallen’s Constant CMA Snubs [EXCLUSIVE] Chris Janson Gets Vocal About Morgan Wallen’s Constant CMA Snubs [EXCLUSIVE]
 Evan Paul Evan Paul Published: November 18, 2026 Getty Images SHARE 
 TWEET 
 Chris Janson isn't holding back when it comes to who he thinks should be nominated for CMA Entertainer of the Year.
 Ahead of tonight's (Nov. 18) CMA Awards, I caught up with Janson on Taste of Country Nights and asked him who he thinks deserves to win the night's biggest award.
 "I'd really give it to Morgan Wallen , if we're being honest here. I mean, it's pretty clear that he plays for the most people," Janson tells me.
 Mike Coppola, Getty Images Mike Coppola, Getty Images Chris Janson Doesn't Understand Morgan Wallen's CMA Snubs
 Janson admits he doesn't know Wallen personally, but he doesn't think that should matter when it comes to recognizing an artist's success.
 "I don't really know Morgan, but I think it's embarrassing that he didn't get nominated for that."
 Read More:   2026 CMA Awards Nomination Snubs + Surprises Reveal a Dangerous Trend 
 It's a pretty strong statement, especially considering the five artists who are competing for the award this year: Luke Combs , Cody Johnson , Ella Langley , Chris Stapleton and Lainey Wilson .
 Morgan Wallen Continues to Draw Massive Crowds
 Wallen has become one of the biggest ticket sellers in country music, regularly playing to massive audiences on his tours. His success and ability to draw fans into stadiums make him an obvious name in the Entertainer of the Year conversation for Janson.
 Of course, the CMA award isn't based on ticket sales alone. The honor recognizes an artist's overall impact throughout the eligibility period, including touring, music, public presence and contributions to country music.

 The winner will be announced as the final award tonight at the 60th annual CMA Awards in Nashville. While Wallen won't be taking home the trophy this year, Janson has made it clear who he believes deserved a spot in the category.
 2025 CMA Awards Nominations: Biggest Snubs + Surprises, Ranked
 It's always shocking when last year's Entertainer of the Year favorite is shut out of this year's nominations. That's mostly what happened to the No. 1 artist on our snubs and surprises list. 
 The 2025 CMA Awards nominations announcement were good to Ella Langley, Lainey Wilson and Megan Moroney, but those women don't make this list. Another most-nominated star does, however, and that's a very good signal for the future of country. Gallery Credit: Billy Dukes 
 2024 ACM Awards Nominations Snubs, Ranked
 The 2024 ACM Awards nominations are here. Megan Moroney is having a very, VERY good day. A long list of veteran country hitmakers are not. 
 Luke Bryan , Jason Aldean , Carrie Underwood , Miranda Lambert and more find themselves without a real reason to attend the 2024 ACM Awards next month. They don't make this list of snubs and surprises, however — scroll down to find our Top 10, starting with an Entertainer of the Year nominee that had never been up for anything before.
